name: What's Involved in a Kitchen Island Installation?

step.name: Step 1: Initial Consultation & Design
step.text: This is where we chat about your vision! We'll discuss your kitchen layout, how much space you have, and what you want your island to do – extra seating, storage, prep space, or even house appliances like a sink or stovetop. We'll explore materials, finishes, and ensure it blends seamlessly with your existing kitchen design. This usually takes a few meetings to really nail down the perfect plan.

step.name: Step 2: Planning & Permits
step.text: Once the design is finalized, we get into the nitty-gritty. If your island needs plumbing, electrical work, or if we're moving load-bearing walls, permits from the local Las Vegas authorities will be necessary. Simply Construction handles all the necessary coordination, drawings, and applications to ensure everything is up to code and ready for construction. This phase can take a few weeks depending on permit office backlogs.

step.name: Step 3: Site Preparation & Utilities Rough-in
step.text: Before any major construction, we'll prep the area. This might involve protecting floors and existing cabinets. If your island includes a sink, dishwasher, or cooktop, our licensed plumbers and electricians will run the necessary water lines, drains, and wiring to the island's location. This 'rough-in' work is crucial for functionality and typically happens over a few days.

step.name: Step 4: Island Framing & Cabinetry Installation
step.text: Now, the island really starts to take shape! We'll build the structural frame for your island, ensuring it's sturdy and perfectly positioned according to the design. Then, the custom or pre-fabricated cabinets are installed, aligning them precisely and securing them in place. This step is usually completed within a week, depending on the complexity of the cabinetry.

step.name: Step 5: Countertop Template & Installation
step.text: With the base cabinets in, we'll take precise measurements for your island countertop. If you've chosen a custom material like granite or quartz, there will be a fabrication period. Once ready, the countertop is carefully delivered and installed, sealed, and polished to perfection. This can take anywhere from a few days to a couple of weeks, largely due to fabrication time.

step.name: Step 6: Finishing Touches & Final Inspection
step.text: Finally, we connect all plumbing and electrical fixtures, install any desired hardware, and complete any backsplash work around the island. After a thorough cleanup, we'll walk through the completed project with you to ensure every detail meets your expectations. Then, if required, final inspections with the city of Las Vegas are coordinated. This last step typically wraps up within a few days. Throughout the entire process, Simply Construction ensures clear communication, keeping you informed every step of the way.
